project.description:
Kranji Reading - an adaptive Chinese reading app for children. Pinyin appears only where the reader has not yet secured the character, and an unfamiliar character can explain its own composition.
Split so the domain stays testable without a browser: -model domain types and the corpus bridge; depends on kranji-core only -content article source SPI and the bundled catalogue -app Homing workspaces, widgets, server; the only crated module -prep preparation and validation CLI, a build-time tool
Dependency rule: -model and -content never depend on Homing, and nothing in Kranji proper depends on kranji-reading.
